families.title: Seafood
paragraphs: Frozen fish and seafood for menus and daily service. A family built to keep product and organise the kitchen ahead of time.
Tell us what you serve and we will guide you on species, format and presentation. Each reference's sheet is confirmed with the team.

families.title: Meat
paragraphs: Frozen meat for the grill, stews, set menus and catering. A stable base to complete the menu and adjust the service.
Tell us the cut, use and format you need. We confirm the reference and its documentation before closing the proposal.

families.title: Prepared dishes
paragraphs: Frozen preparations and vegetables to complete a service, solve a side dish or lighten kitchen prep.
Tell us what you need to prepare and for how many services. We help you confirm product, format and storage.

families.title: Pastry
paragraphs: Frozen desserts and pastry to complete the dessert offer without adding load to the kitchen.
Ask for the presentation you need and request the reference sheet. The team will guide you on format, storage and service.

families.title: Bakery
paragraphs: Frozen bread and viennoiserie to complete the bread service and solve breakfast or a snack without adding load to the kitchen.
Tell us the format you need and for how many services. The team confirms the reference, storage and documentation.

families.title: Chilled products
families.tag: Cheese, smoked fish and foie gras
paragraphs: Cheese, smoked salmon and foie gras to complete a board, a starter or a menu preparation. Chilled product with its own storage and handling.
Tell us the use and format you need. We confirm the reference, shelf life and documentation before closing the proposal.

families.title: Sauces and preparations
paragraphs: Sauces, potatoes and preparations to solve a side dish or complete a plate without starting from scratch.
Ask for the presentation you need. The team will guide you on format, storage and use in the kitchen.
